data.message: Fisher09: I commit to 18 tons; I invite each of you to opt in individually, not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Thus recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each fisher: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
